canonical_name: Crucible runner capability manifest V1 runtime consumer acceptance receipt
append_only: A later acceptance is a new receipt file; this one is never rewritten. It does not replace docs/authority/receipts/crucible-runner-fact-v1-consumer-receipt.json or the terminal valuation receipts, which stay the records of the revisions they accepted.

producer.byte_check: each local file equals `git -C <custos> show 8cda48da:<producer_path>` by SHA-256 and by Git blob OID
producer.synthetic_runtime: the producer generator declares sha256: followed by 64 sevens, revision of 40 eights, nautilus 2.0.0rc5+sodex.2; synthetic, not a published image

consumer.migration: none; the runtime is stored with the manifest in the existing runner_capability_versions JSONB column

acceptance_domain.object: required; exactly distribution, image_digest, source_revision, engine, engine_version; a JSON object only
acceptance_domain.oci_image: image_digest sha256: plus 64 lowercase hex; source_revision 40 lowercase hex; whole value, no trailing newline
acceptance_domain.development: image_digest and source_revision present and JSON null; a missing key is refused, not read as null
acceptance_domain.vectors: the 5 accepted and 29 refused shapes of custos tests/test_runtime_identity.py plus 10 consumer-side refusals (positional array, development without image_digest key, 65-digit digest, SHA256: prefix, trailing newline on digest and revision, sha512:, non-string engine, boolean digest, array revision)

consumer.reader: store::load_runner_runtime_identity(control_pool, tenant_id, runner_id, capability_version_id) and PgRunnerCapabilityAuthorityRepository::runtime_identity; exact version, same strict manifest type
consumer.qualification: a sandbox source is keyed by the runtime its runner's frozen capability declares; candidates are the tenant's testnet instances of the same release, each keyed by the runtime every capability version named in its current generation's RunnerFact batch headers declares; development, mixed or unsigned runs never match
consumer.legacy_manifest: a stored manifest without runtime no longer decodes: health readiness reports `current manifest is invalid` and the reader returns InvalidManifest until the runner publishes its capability again

verification.producer_bytes_accepted_unchanged: the vendored manifest decodes and passes semantic validation; its canonical digest equals the manifest_digest of the vendored capability receipt golden (runner_capability_publication::tests::the_custos_manifest_asset_is_accepted_with_its_runtime_and_digest); the golden batch and both terminal boundary batches are ingested under the new manifest digest (runner_fact_transport_pg, economic settlement terminal scenarios)
